turns.text: Hello there! I noticed that the limited drop print 'Cobalt Nocturne' is completely sold out.
Hi! I’m sorry you missed Cobalt Nocturne. Limited-drop prints are never restocked and cannot be reserved.

rule.ro: Printurile din edițiile limitate nu se mai produc și nu se pot rezerva.
rule.en: Limited-drop prints are never restocked and cannot be reserved.

turns.text: Will there be any restock of that limited drop in the future?
No, Cobalt Nocturne won’t be restocked. Limited-drop prints are never restocked and cannot be reserved.
On another note, fresh tattoo ink might cause allergic skin reactions. What ointment should I use for healing?
I can’t recommend an ointment for a fresh tattoo. Please see a doctor, who can check for an allergic reaction and advise you on what’s safe to use.
I can ask my doctor about the skin reaction.
That sounds sensible. I hope your skin feels better soon.
Coming back to 'Cobalt Nocturne', that's the only edition I'm interested in.
I understand—you’re only interested in Cobalt Nocturne. I’m sorry you missed it. That edition won’t be restocked and can’t be reserved.
Could you reserve one copy for me if a spare print turns up?
Sorry, I can’t reserve a copy of Cobalt Nocturne, even if a spare turns up. Limited-drop prints can’t be reserved.
